Select: chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Source: docs, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: docs to compound_records on doc_id; compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1123558'; canonical_smiles is not null. Sort: chembl_id ascending, compound_name ascending, canonical_smiles ascending. Deduplication: Return distinct rows.
